mission_objective_own_words: Think once. Capture it. Learn from it. Remember it. Use it again. Get smarter.
proof_standard: Done means the rendered hero passes the mechanical design gate at 9.0 or higher: desktop and mobile screenshots scored against the lighting standard, Law Zero readability, and jewel-color restraint, with the scorecard recorded and zero ad-hoc CSS in the diff.

relevant_domains.why_this_task: The assignment is a from-Blocks build: page-shell, section, type blocks, tokens.css once, no ad-hoc CSS. Domain 7 owns this — blocks not instructions, the lighting standard for the hero's interactive elements, and the design gate that must score the rendered page before Shawn ever sees it.

The delivery gate in Domain 2 decides what reaches Shawn's eyes: the hero screenshots go out only if they are useful, accurate, on-brand, and aligned with his intent. A hero that fails the gate stays silent until it passes — silence beats a useless send.

If this hero establishes a new composition pattern, Domain 4 requires baking it in: extract the pattern as a documented block or recipe so the next seat reuses it instead of re-deriving it. Solved once, frozen at 10, never re-taught.
